name: SVC_MCA_TOOLBAR
description: This table is used to store the toolbar details associated  to the SVC MCA setup.  A toolbar specific configuration defines attributes to display/render toolbar. It also specifies which configuration it supports.

columns.name: TOOLBAR_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name which uniquely defines this toolbar.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: The Display Name presented to the user for this Toolbar

columns.name: TOOLBAR_LABEL
columns.description: The user friendly label for the toolbar.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: The URL for the toolbar rendering.

columns.name: URL_VALID_DOMAIN_NAME
columns.description: The domain name for optional redirection.

columns.name: PREFERRED_HEIGHT
columns.description: The preferred height of the toolbar in pixels.

columns.name: PREFERRED_WIDTH
columns.description: The preferred width of the toolbar in pixels.

columns.name: ORIENTATION
columns.description: The orientation of the toolbar.  Either HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL

columns.name: VENDOR
columns.description: Optional field for the name of the Vendor.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this toolbar is available for use.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the toolbar should be visible by default

columns.name: LW_ACCEPT_ON_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the Accept/Reject Dialog should be shown in Live Window for incoming engagements from this toolbar.

columns.name: SUPPORTED_CHANNELS
columns.description: This is the comma delimited list of channel types supported by the toolbar.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is logically deleted (Y or N).
